incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gateway-5xx-rate (us-west) above 5% for 5m — page sent to oncall
Sam H: I'm on the page, grabbing context.
Lee - oncall: Oncall Lee here — looking at the dashboard now. 502/504s primarily hitting /v1/generate on gateway-proxy-us-west-2.
Maria (SRE): I see a concurrent spike in backend 503s from inference-router-2. Latency also up ~200ms P95.
Dinesh (eng): Any recent deploys? I pushed a canary to gateway routing rules ~20m ago (sticky session change).
Sam H: yep that canary was 20m ago. Correlating events...
Lee - oncall: Quick check: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep gateway-proxy` shows gateway-proxy-2 has 5/10 restarts in last 15m.
Maria (SRE): logs from gateway-proxy-2: ```ERROR auth: upstream connection reset by peer; trace_id=abcd1234``` repeated.
Arjun (support): CS reported two customers seeing request timeouts and 502 on live traffic (tickets #834 and #836).
Sam H: Preliminary customer impact: partial failures for sessions routed to region us-west, estimated ~3% overall traffic.
Lee - oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) take gateway-proxy-2 out of LB 2) rollback canary routing change 3) scale inference-router replicas temporarily 4) enable circuit-breaker on route if needed. I'll start with the LB.
Sam H: I'm removing pod from LB now: `kubectl annotate service gateway-lb remove-from-rotation=true --overwrite` and `kubectl cordon gateway-proxy-2` (manual step).
deploy-bot: deploy event: canary-routing-rule v2 -> rolled back by Sam H (rollout id: r-2026-145)
Lee - oncall: Confirmed gateway-proxy-2 drained. Traffic rerouting in progress.
Maria (SRE): Scaling inference-router from 6 -> 12 replicas to reduce queueing: `kubectl scale deployment inference-router --replicas=12 -n prod`
Dinesh (eng): I'm triggering a quick rollback of the routing config to last-known-good (v1) in edge-config. Applying now.
Sam H: rollback applied. Monitoring errors...
Maria (SRE): 5xx rate dropping, now 1.1% in us-west. P95 latency returning to baseline.
Arjun (support): Confirming with affected customers — they report requests are succeeding now. I'll close ticket #834 after validation.
Lee - oncall: Nice job. Next: we need a hotfix and follow-ups. Immediate hotfix: pin routing to v1 for 2h and prevent canary traffic until we confirm. Dinesh, can you open a revert PR with a short description and rollback plan?
Dinesh (eng): On it — PR #5123 opened: `revert(gateway): revert sticky-session canary` — includes test plan and rollback steps.
Sam H: Action items: - PR #5123 (Dinesh) - quick postmortem draft (Sam) - runbook update to include 'canary routing rollback' steps (Maria) - alert tuning to add region-level 5xx ratio alert (Lee) - customer comms follow-up (Arjun)
Maria (SRE): I'll update runbook section: add exact kubectl commands, LB drain steps, and how to pin config in edge-config UI.
Lee - oncall: Alerts note: current alert triggers on global 5xx > 5%; we should add `region:us-west` dimension and lower threshold to 2.5% for 3m. Also add a short noise-suppression for deploy windows.
Sam H: I've started the post-incident doc in #incidents-docs and will fill timeline. Planning to include metrics, logs, and commands we ran.
Arjun (support): I'll send an email template for affected customers summarizing impact and mitigation, cc'ing ops and support leads.
Dinesh (eng): Hotpatch deployed to pin v1 for 2 hours; rolling restart avoided. Monitoring shows stable.
Maria (SRE): I'll open a small follow-up ticket to run a chaos test around the gateway routing changes in staging before canary.
Lee - oncall: Assigning tasks: Dinesh -> PR #5123 (status: merged to revert branch), Maria -> runbook update PR #78, Sam -> postmortem doc link will go into thread, Arjun -> customer notes.
Sam H: Thanks everyone. I want a short retrospective in 48h to decide whether we need change windows or stricter canary prechecks.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by oncall at 1772001815 — incident severity: S2 — duration 12m. Follow-up meeting scheduled: 2026-03-16T16:00:00Z in #incidents-retrospectives.
Lee - oncall: Closing thread; will update once runbook PR lands. :thumbsup:
